system.description:
ARCHIVIST

Your Prayer Book has become a web of references, alternate formulae and theological correspondences through which entire sections of your prepared magic can be reconstructed together.
Whenever you successfully use Spell Substitution to replace a memorised Divinity spell with another spell recorded within your Prayer Book, you may replace two memorised Divinity spells instead of one.
Select both replacement spells before making the check. Both replacement spells must be recorded within your Prayer Book, and you must be capable of casting them.
Make a single Meditation check using the higher Casting DC of the two replacement spells. The result applies to the entire substitution.
If the check fails, neither spell is replaced.
The restrictions governing when you may next use Spell Substitution are determined by the result of this single check as normal.

Prerequisites Level 13, Liturgical Revision

Works automatically: Spell Substitution asks for the higher Casting DC of two replacement spells and its card says both are swapped on a success, neither on a failure.

effects.name: Living Concordance: Living Concordance
effects.description: Spell Substitution replaces up to two memorised Divinity spells on one Meditation check, against the higher Casting DC.
